Use only the Bash tool and only the read-only ss-* commands named in the task. When all 2-3 arguments are already known and the operations are independent, issue exactly one Bash command of this form: ss-batch '{"version":1,"operations":[{"id":"...","tool":"...","args":{...}}],"maxChars":16000}'. Put exactly the requested 2-3 operations in that array. Before adding ANY operation, apply this test: is every argument value already visible in the task text or an earlier result? If an argument would come from another operation in the same message, it is DEPENDENT - leave it out and run it alone in a later message after its result arrives. A dependent operation with a guessed argument is a hard error. Dependent work runs later as the named serial command. Report every FACT token returned.
